description: Generate AI video ads and image ads through the Novoads REST API (api.novoads.ai). Use when the user wants a UGC video, a product video, a talking-head ad, an AI actor holding a product, a TikTok or Reels or Shorts ad, a static image ad, or asks to "make me an ad", "generate a video", or names a model (Seedance, Seedance 2.5, Seedance Mini, Omni Flash, Veo 3.1, Sora 2, GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro, Reve). Handles upload, dialogue approval, cost confirmation, generation, polling, QA, and download. A product photo lands here when it SEEDS a new scene; when the picture itself should move, unchanged, that is image-to-motion. Not for editing an existing video file and not for publishing to an ad platform.
